## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Saint-Martin-Boulogne, France. It starts at Boulevard Sainte-Beuve.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> How many animals can you fit into 10 million litres of water? Quite a few, it turns out! Get your hands on a ticket for Europe's largest aquariums, and prepare for an amazing underwater adventure filled with unforgettable marine wildlife encounters.
>
> Watch over 50,000 animals swimming around one of the most impressive aquariums in the world, which is also recognised by UNESCO. See grey sharks, a giant manta ray, incredible jellyfish, a sea turtle, penguins, crocodiles, and more.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €31.22. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 723 ratings and 320 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
